headline: Claude Maps the Bug Hunter’s Playbook
lede: Claude-BugHunter turns authorized penetration testing into a disciplined, evidence-first workflow. Its 83 skills, vulnerability patterns, reconnaissance routines, and reporting scaffolds give security researchers a controlled way to move from discovery to disclosure.

headline: An Agent Builds the Last 30 Days
lede: Last30days-skill pulls fresh signals from social networks, news, markets, video, research, and code communities into one attributable brief. Parallel search and source-weighted synthesis give researchers a flowing view of what changed—and where the evidence came from.

headline: Open Code Review Brings Context to the CLI
lede: Alibaba’s command-line reviewer combines deterministic file selection with agentic investigation across changes and full codebases. It returns precise, line-level findings for defects ranging from thread-safety errors to injection risks, with JSON output and resumable sessions for serious workflows.

headline: LoopForge Turns Coding Agents into Delivery Systems
lede: LoopForge gives coding agents an operational blueprint: provision a workspace, assign roles, run defined stages, and pause for human approval. Docker sandboxes, checkpoints, artifacts, and rerunnable SOP nodes make autonomous delivery inspectable rather than improvised.

headline: Univer Builds Office Surfaces for Any Product
lede: Univer brings spreadsheets, documents, and presentations into an embeddable, plugin-first SDK. Its Canvas renderer and shared browser-to-Node API let teams compose polished office experiences while keeping formulas, editing, and headless processing inside their own products.

headline: Arcane Makes Docker Operations Approachable
lede: Arcane puts containers, images, volumes, networks, and Compose stacks behind a clean self-hosted interface. It gives homelabs and small teams a reliable control plane for everyday Docker administration without surrendering ownership of the host or its data.

headline: Stitch Skills Sketch a Faster Route to Frontend Code
lede: Stitch Skills connects visual design work to coding agents through MCP and reusable workflow packages. Generate screens, extract design systems, refine themes, and turn prototypes into React, React Native, Vite, shadcn/ui, or Remotion projects through an iterative build loop.

headline: Cursor’s Plugin Shelf Extends the Agent
lede: Cursor’s catalog gathers reusable skills, integrations, and workflows under a consistent manifest format. The collection spans code review, orchestration, learning, CRM, documents, and business systems—an expanding reference shelf for agents working beyond the editor.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents a Construction Plan
lede: Superpowers starts with requirements, validates a design, and breaks implementation into small tested tasks before an agent writes the code. Worktrees, red-green TDD, review gates, and explicit plans turn agentic development into a repeatable build sequence.

headline: AG-UI Connects Agents to Living Interfaces
lede: AG-UI defines a compact event protocol for streaming chat, synchronized state, generative UI, tools, and human approval. Its transport-neutral design gives agent frameworks and frontends a common systems layer across HTTP, SSE, WebSockets, and webhooks.
